name: Bad Wünnenberg (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, white and red in the proportions 1:3:1, charged towards the hoist with the city arms of Bad Wünnenberg (a red cross between ears of wheat above flames on white).
history: By deed of the Regierungspräsident of 28 July 1986 the city was granted the right to bear a flag, described as red-white-red 1:3:1 striped with the city shield shifted from the centre towards the staff.

features.role: Bad Wünnenberg arms — cross, ears and flames on white
